Tylenol 3 and Dreams
I recently had surgery to repair my ingrown toenail, I was given Tylenol 3's to help with my pain.   Something I realized though that after taking a pill before sleeping or even napping I tend to have very strange/educational dreams.
The first night after taking 1 pill I had a very educational dream about money and investing, I was hanging out with Mark Zuckerberg in my dream and he was teaching me on how I should invest money at my age to ensure a successful future.  It is all very fuzzy to me now, but I do remember he gave me some very good advice.
The next day (today) I remember taking a short 45-minute nap on the couch because the pills had me feeling drowsy, and when I fell asleep I seemed to have woken up in a different reality.   I remember that in my dream I was watching a video on YouTube and when I finished I wanted to tell my parents about it, although they were not home but my brother and one of his black friends (which I know at school in real life but never really talk to) were home, so I struck a conversation with his friend, I do not remember what the conversation was about although I remember it was very laid back and relaxed.
I ended up getting woken up from my dream by a phone call and I havent slept since, although it is late at night as I wright this and I am going to go to bed after and hope for the best.
